children: Japan's Nikkei stock average fell more than 4% on Friday to touch a seven-month low, as technology shares tumbled after Anthropic's IPO failed to restore confidence in AI trade.
fell as much as 4.85% to 56,594.94, its lowest level since mid-April, and was down 4.33% to 56,871.78 as of 0210 GMT.

"There was a high expectation that Anthropic's market debut may lift sentiment for AI-related shares, but that hope faded as its price pared gains," said Hiroyuki Ueno, chief strategist at Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Asset Management.
, the world's first publicly traded frontier AI company, opened 34% higher than the $83 IPO price set on Wednesday. But the stock pared gains and closed at $97.17, up 17% from its IPO price.
